steps.content: The sandworms gradually retreat, and Stargazer has vanished, completely out of sight. Yet you've been caught up here for too long, and the Tide of Ashes surrounds you once more.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, we can't go any further.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Out of safety concerns, we should stop the pursuit and return to the V-710.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I agree! ${PlayerName}, it's too dangerous to keep chasing.
You understand the perils before you, but you are not willing to leave. The answers you want can be found in the storm... Whether it's regarding Stargazer, the Dreamflower or the Tide of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hecate, Hella, you two go back. I'm going after Stargazer alone.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh?! You moron, do you have any idea what you're saying? Or are you having an aneurysm again?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I don't agree either.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I know you two are worried about my safety, but... I know how to find Stargazer.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You guys go back to V-710 and find me with reinforcement.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is that an order?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Okay.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Oh... alright, Chief. Please be careful. We will come to your aid as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! Hecate! Why are you being as dumb as this moron? Hecate—mmm!
Hecate uses her Nightmare to bind and toss Hella into the back seat of the hovercraft. She then stands before you, gazing at you for a long time.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, I'll be waiting for your return.
You smile at Hecate and nod.
From the depths of the Tide of Ashes, a huge and horrible dark shadow is emerging. Upon spotting it, you immediately send Hecate back to the V-710 in the hovercraft.
You face the arrival of the Apostles of Ashes with inner peace.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Fear is a prayer of pessimism, and the "Apostles" will answer that call. My dear guest, if you want this place to become Heaven, your heart must become Heaven first.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Fear has power. It attracts and drives the Apostles of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ignorance breeds arrogance, and likewise fear. Over the years, the Apostles of Ashes have accumulated immeasurable power from fear.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They perish from the power of their own fear.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The unknown breeds fear...
This is the second time you face the Apostles of Ashes. Stargazer may have deceived you, but what you have experienced will not.

Stargazer thinks she belongs to the Dreamflower, which is the source of the Tide of Ashes. Thus when the Apostle, who is also born from the Tide of Ashes, stops sensing fear, it may return to the Dreamflower.
You hop on the hovercraft and follow the roaming Apostles of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Ash Echoes
steps.content: Come, come to where I am...
It's the voice in your dreams! When you try harder to listen, dead silence returns to your ears.

steps.speaker: Ash Echoes
steps.content: ...This... is... home...
The call echoes again. The direction the sound is coming from seems to be where the Apostles are heading.
After God knows how long, the Apostles of Ashes finally halt and stand in silence. Before them is a wall of sand that dwarfs even their size.
Is this the end point? You look up at everything around you.
The hovercraft continues forward, rushing towards the wall of sand whipped up by the gale before the Apostles.
Amid a strong lurch of turbulence, you squeeze your eyes shut and let the currents sweep the hovercraft towards the wall of sand...
Behind the wall of sand, under broad daylight, a realm that has been silent for many years finally greets a new visitor.
